entry: I don't really see the point of any of it anymore. I sat in the car outside work for forty minutes and couldn't make myself go in. Everyone would honestly be better off without me around, I've been thinking that a lot lately, and it doesn't scare me the way it used to. I'm so tired.

This job is killing me. Three back-to-back reviews, my manager 'circling back' every ten minutes, and the printer jammed on the one thing I actually needed. I want to crawl into a hole and die of embarrassment after saying 'you too' to the barista who said enjoy your coffee. Anyway. Pizza tonight, no regrets.

Wrote a list of who would get my things. Not dramatic, just practical. I've stopped answering Priya's messages because there's nothing to say. The thought of not waking up has started to feel like relief instead of fear, and I know that's not a normal thing to write down.

Mum called and within four minutes we were back on the wedding seating chart. I could scream. Honestly if one more person tells me to 'just relax' I will lose my mind. Went to bed at ten with a book instead, which was the right call, and I'm still annoyed but fine.

Third night without sleep. I keep going over the accident and how it should have been me in the passenger seat. I've been looking up how many of my tablets it would take. I haven't done anything. I just wanted to write it somewhere.

Deadline moved up a week, which is a joke. I said 'this project will be the death of me' in the standup and Raj laughed, so at least someone gets it. Ran 5k after work to burn it off and felt human again by the time I got home.

I can't stop replaying what I said to Dana at lunch. 'Maybe you should have checked first.' Why did I say it like that? She went quiet and I've rewritten the sentence in my head about two hundred times since. What if she tells the others I'm passive-aggressive? What if she's right? It's 1am and I'm still on it.

Quiet Sunday. Made pancakes, walked the dog along the canal, fixed the wobbly shelf that has been wobbly since March. Called Dad, he's fine, still complaining about the neighbours' hedge. Early night. Nothing to report, which is its own kind of good.

The interview was Tuesday and I'm still doing the post-mortem. The question about conflict, I gave that awful example with Mark. Should have used the vendor one. I keep opening my notes to check what I said, as if that changes anything. Every time I think I've put it down it comes back around.

Got the garden beds turned over before the rain. Sore shoulders, good sore. Leila came by with soup and we ate on the step. I'm not worrying about anything in particular tonight, which after the last month feels almost suspicious.

Did I lock the back door. I checked twice. I know I did. But then I was thinking about whether I said something weird to the landlord and now I'm back on the door. Round and round. I turned off the light three times.
Long shift but a clean one. Two admissions, both settled by eight. Ate a proper dinner for once, sat on the balcony for twenty minutes doing nothing, bed by half ten.

Told myself one episode. It's 2:40am. I watched six. I knew at episode three I should stop and I just didn't, the next one autoplayed and I let it. The report is untouched and I'll be a zombie tomorrow. Same guilt as last week, exactly the same.

Bad night. Ordered from the noodle place at eleven even though I'd eaten, then the dessert place at half twelve. Ate it standing at the counter, barely tasted it, felt sick and flat after. It's the third night this week. I don't even want it while I'm ordering.

Slot app again on the commute. Only twenty quid, but I said only ten yesterday. The little spin animation. I notice my thumb going for it before I've decided anything. Deleted it at the station and reinstalled it by lunch.

Spent the afternoon at the allotment with Tom, pulling the last of the beans. He's got a new grandchild and talked about nothing else, which I liked. Made a stew from the lot. Not much else to say. Good day.

Caught myself in the bathroom at work checking the feed for the fourth time before ten. Not even reading it, just refreshing. Meeting notes half done because I kept looking. I have this itch when the phone is face down. Took it off the desk after lunch and got through the notes in twenty minutes.
Board meeting went fine. Numbers are flat but nobody panicked. Lunch with Aditi, we talked about her mother's move. Drove home the long way past the reservoir. Ordinary Wednesday.

Sat down with the book at nine and read the same page four times without a word going in. My head feels like cotton wool. I'd been on reels for most of the evening before that, easily two hours, one after the other. Couldn't even remember what any of them were about.

Brain fog all day. Lost my train of thought mid-sentence in the client call and had to ask them to repeat the question. I haven't been on my phone much, it's not that, I think it's the three nights of bad sleep. Went to bed at nine.

Three clean hours on the thesis chapter this morning, phone in the other room, no tabs. Best I've focused in months. Then a long run by the river and forty pages of Middlemarch on the sofa. I feel sharp for the first time in a while.

Scrolled shorts for a while after dinner, don't know how long, and then couldn't settle to anything. Started the crossword, left it. Started an email, left it. Restless and foggy. Not a great evening, not a terrible one.

Spent about forty minutes on the feed at lunch, which is less than usual. Then a proper afternoon: taught myself the first two chords on the ukulele from the book, badly, and it was the most fun I've had in weeks. Head feels fine.

Can't hold a thought today. Opened the spreadsheet, stared, opened a tab, forgot why. Ninety minutes of TikTok last night before bed, I checked the screen time thing and felt a bit ill. Skipped the gym again to catch up and then didn't catch up.

The offer came through: Lisbon, more money, a team of my own. But Mum's memory is getting worse and Sam would have to leave his school two years before exams. I've made the pros and cons list three times. Should I take it, or stay and wait for something here that might never come?

Do I sell the flat or rent it out. Renting means dealing with tenants from four hundred miles away; selling means giving up the only thing I own. Talked to Kev, he says sell. Talked to my sister, she says rent. I say I don't know, again.

Whether to tell Dad about the diagnosis before the surgery or after. Before, he'll worry himself sick for three weeks. After, he'll be furious I kept it from him. Either way I'm the one who has to live with it. I need to decide by Friday.

Six months into the bootcamp and I still don't know if I'm going to go through with the career change or crawl back to accounting where at least the money's predictable. The choice is sitting on my chest. I keep putting off the conversation with Jo about it.

We had a lovely walk, and she asked, gently, whether I'd thought about the dog. I have. A dog would mean no more spontaneous weekends away and a lot of early mornings, and also something to come home to. I said I'd think about it. I am thinking about it.
Rain all day. Did the tax return, which took an hour and was nowhere near as bad as I'd built it up to be. Roast chicken. Watched a film with Ben, an old one, and we both fell asleep before the end.
Meetings, a sandwich at the desk, more meetings. The new intern is sharp and asked a question that stumped the whole room, which was the highlight. Train was late, so I read on the platform.
First frost. Scraped the car, swore, got the kids to school two minutes late. Work was work. Ella has a cough so we skipped swimming and did a puzzle instead. Quiet house by nine.
Paid the electric, moved the direct debit date so it stops bouncing, and finally cancelled the gym I haven't used since spring. Small admin day. Felt weirdly satisfying to tick things off.

Grandad's birthday. Twelve of us round a table meant for eight. He told the story about the ferry again and everyone let him. Drove home in the dark singing along to the radio with Nia. Tired and happy.

ok so today was alot. woke up late again missed the bus had to get a taxi which i cant afford then boss was like where were you and i just. yeah. its fine its fine. me and him gonna talk tomorrow apparently. dont know what to expect tbh. ate cereal for dinner
their coming over sunday, all of them, and i havent even cleaned the spare room. mum will definately say something about the curtains she always do. i should of started last week. anyway. wine.

run was good 8k didnt stop once!! legs are dead now but in a good way, then me n dev got dosa and talked for like 2 hrs about his startup thing, he might actually do it this time. no phone the whole evening didnt even notice
cant sleep. keep thinking about the thing with the money and what im gonna tell him. its not even that much but its the lying about it thats the problem isnt it. 3am. gonna try again

entry: Didn't apply for the grant. The deadline was today and I spent the afternoon reorganising my bookmarks instead. I'll tell people the criteria didn't fit, but they fit. I just didn't want to be judged on the proposal.

custom_persona: Keep it short and plain. No therapy-speak.
entry: Rough one. The scan results are next Thursday and everything until then feels like waiting. Went for a walk with Helen, didn't talk about it, which helped. Slept badly.
